name: SceneReplica
summary: 用于复现真实机器人抓取与放置实验的标准化场景基准，提供 YCB 物体场景、RGB-D 元数据、抓取数据和仿真到真实环境的搭建工具。
summaryEn: A standardized benchmark for replicating real-world robot pick-and-place experiments, with YCB scenes, RGB-D metadata, grasp data, and sim-to-real setup tools.
scale: 20 selected replicable YCB scenes with grasp and scene metadata
scaleZh: 20 个可复现 YCB 场景及其抓取和场景元数据
organizationsZh: 得克萨斯大学达拉斯分校
license: Code is MIT; linked data assets may have separate terms
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；所链接数据资源可能适用单独条款
access: Official repository links scene, grasp, and model files
accessZh: 官方仓库提供场景、抓取和模型文件入口
wmNote: 同一场景可在仿真和真实系统中复建，适合诊断感知、规划和控制链路；规模小于通用操作语料。
wmNoteEn: Scenes can be recreated in simulation and on real systems for diagnosing perception, planning, and control, though the corpus is smaller than general manipulation datasets.
